applyTo: "**/legal/**,**/mevzuat/**,**/official_capture/**,**/*legal*,**/*law*"

# Official and legal sources
- Distinguish URL, canonical official publisher, native bytes, metadata, hash, manifest and independent authority evidence.
- Do not treat official-looking links, HTML or derivative documents as verified native official publications.
- Require provenance, independently frozen inventories, authentic captures, SHA-256 and custody readback before declaring legal evidence accepted.
- Never invent or replace missing source bytes, dates, signatures or authority receipts. Missing mandatory evidence means HOLD/NO-GO.
